audit.action: a better source should be cited for the same classification
audit.reasoning: The classification (fixed-dominant, initial: initial stress) rests on Meakins 2013 APiCS survey ch. 72, a grammar sketch by the language's principal describer; we held no copy, so I downloaded it and confirmed the deciding sentence verbatim in section 4 Phonology. The record's grade/quote fields are empty even though the source text is in 'sources'; with the file now obtained and the quote confirmed, the strength of the evidence can be filled/upgraded. No better stress source appears to exist: Glottolog's 7 descriptive refs are all morphosyntax-oriented works by the same team; the 2008 PhD/2011 book phonology appendix (downloaded, pp. 357-361) is silent on stress; published instrumental work on GK covers vowels, VOT, fricatives and stop perception, not prosody; Crossref/OpenAlex/UQ eSpace show no GK stress/prosody/intonation study. Initial stress is also consistent with both source languages (Gurindji, Pama-Nyu

sources.note: A 2AFC perception study of stop voicing testing whether Gurindji Kriol keeps separate Gurindji- and Kriol-derived phonological strata; it sets out GK's stratified phoneme inventories.
